title: PatientSummary
description: Patient-level rollup. One per patient. Consumed by vMTB and MTB-lite as the primary input. Every factual field carries source_refs that point into the bucket-co-located text-masked MD sidecar set.

alias.description: Display alias: {patient_id_short}_{cancer_code}_{year} (e.g. 17CE02_CRC_2019). Optional — set ONLY when the user explicitly opted in (alias_opt_in) after seeing the re-identification risk; default absent/null.

name.description: Patient name (may be partially Phase-1-masked). Sole purpose: the P0 cross_patient_name_collision check (name + dob_year) in organizer-prompt-phase2-synthesis.md Step 3a. Null when fully masked → the check skips. Not surfaced in any patient-facing artifact.

regimen.description: Flat human-readable verbatim string. e.g. '雷替曲塞 5mg d1 + 信迪利单抗 200mg d2 q21d (cycle 2)'.

latest_status.description: Single-time-point snapshot of the patient's most recent status. Per bucket-taxonomy.md §3 this snapshot lives here while the full trajectory lives in longitudinal_observations.json (see longitudinal_observations_ref).

regimen.description: Flat human-readable verbatim string of the most recent regimen.

longitudinal_observations_ref.description: Optional patient-dir-relative path to longitudinal_observations.json (the multi-time-point trajectory store, schema longitudinal_observations_v1). Typically 'longitudinal_observations.json' beside profile.json. Consumers read latest_status for the snapshot and follow this ref for the full 单时间点→纵向曲线→治疗反应轨迹 series. See bucket-taxonomy.md §3.

confidence.description: Per-key extraction confidence (0–1), populated by synthesis worker. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all per-section confidence — individual section objects (e.g. diagnosis) must NOT carry their own inner confidence. Keys are constrained to a canonical closed set matching the structured-file names, eliminating labs vs lab_values drift; all keys optional.

items.description: Anchor token normalized to the path-only string. File anchors begin with an NN_ clinical-domain bucket prefix (01_…14_) and point to a text-masked MD sidecar inside its bucket; conversation anchors are the literal 'conversation:<ISO8601>'. The infrastructure vault raw/ and quarantine 99_无关文件/ are never anchor targets, and the retired ocr/ / 02_脱敏病历/ prefixes are rejected. Optional fragment is #L<start>-L<end> or #section-anchor.
